Metadata.AutocompletePath: Candide.Terminal.GameTerminal.SuggestCommand(string), using Commands.Keys plus per-command suggestion delegates

Commands.Name: load
Commands.Summary: Imports a script file and runs it as Lua.

Commands.Name: item
Commands.Summary: Adds an item cheat when connected and cheats are enabled.

Commands.Name: spawn
Commands.Summary: Spawns one entity or doodad at the player, or requests the server to spawn it.

Commands.Name: mass_spawn
Commands.Summary: Spawns or requests a 25 by 40 entity grid.

Commands.Name: dynamic-spawn
Commands.Summary: Requests dynamic entity spawning, optionally with instant aggro.

Commands.Name: spawn_all_creatures
Commands.Summary: Spawns every creature GUID near the player.

Commands.Name: construct
Commands.Summary: Requests construction placement at the player.

Commands.Name: tp
Commands.Summary: Teleports to tile coordinates; the handler multiplies by 16 and jumps the camera.

Commands.Name: debuggeneral
Commands.Summary: Toggles Globals.Debug, enabling broad debug UI features.

Commands.Name: debugchunks
Commands.Summary: Toggles exterior world chunk debug rendering.

Commands.Name: tac
Commands.Summary: Clears logs for a time analyzer.

Commands.Name: mode
Commands.Summary: Sets the engine mode manager by numeric value.

Commands.Name: playerstate
Commands.Summary: Prints the current player state machine state.

Commands.Name: name
Commands.Summary: Sets player name; no argument reports the current name.

Commands.Name: detach
Commands.Summary: Requests detach for the held entity.

Commands.Name: nextday
Commands.Summary: Requests a server time skip to the next day.

Commands.Name: hour
Commands.Summary: Requests server time set to a day-hour value.

Commands.Name: resettime
Commands.Summary: Requests time reset to day 1 at 00:00.

Commands.Name: instantactions
Commands.Summary: Toggles instant actions when cheats are enabled.

Commands.Name: health
Commands.Summary: Sets player health; default is max health.

Commands.Name: networkstats
Commands.Summary: Enables network stats or prints current network stats.

Commands.Name: zoom
Commands.Summary: Sets camera and zoom scale; default is 1.

Commands.Name: framestepper_stepframes
Commands.Summary: Runs N frames with the frame stepper.

Commands.Name: toggle_spawn_system
Commands.Summary: Toggles the spawn system disabled flag.

Commands.Name: weather
Commands.Summary: Requests a weather cheat at the player position.

Commands.Name: marcopolo
Commands.Summary: Copies server world tiles/heights locally and discovers dungeons/bosses while local hosting.

Commands.Name: load_in_world_file
Commands.Summary: Loads a world map file into the exterior world at the player while local hosting.

Commands.Name: poi
Commands.Summary: Spawns a registered POI near the player.

Commands.Name: enter
Commands.Summary: Enters a specified building or the exterior under the player.

Commands.Name: exit
Commands.Summary: Exits a building or dungeon, or exits a specified building.

Commands.Name: boss
Commands.Summary: Requests boss spawn at the player.

Commands.Name: aura
Commands.Summary: Applies an aura to the player.

Commands.Name: lagsmoothmode
Commands.Summary: Sets lag smoothing mode; default is 3.

Commands.Name: save_game
Commands.Summary: Queues server game save while local hosting.

Commands.Name: seed
Commands.Summary: Copies and prints the world seed.

Commands.Name: die
Commands.Summary: Requests player death mode 0; arguments are rejected with 'Use .health instead'.

Commands.Name: connection_address
Commands.Summary: Copies and prints connection address or Steam relay ID.

Commands.Name: raid_new
Commands.Summary: Spawns a raid targeting the town under the player.

Commands.Name: raid_arrive
Commands.Summary: Forces the current town raid to arrive.

Commands.Name: raid_beat
Commands.Summary: Marks the current town raid beaten.

Commands.Name: raid_fail
Commands.Summary: Marks the current town raid failed.

Commands.Name: buildings_construct_all
Commands.Summary: Spawns every base building and upgrade chain in rows near the player.

Commands.Name: all_pois
Commands.Summary: Spawns all POIs matching an optional prefix while local hosting, including flipped variants.

Commands.Name: furniture_add_all
Commands.Summary: Adds every furniture entry by count when cheats are enabled.
